respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture shows an enterprise streaming and data lake platform. The frontend and MetaManager microservices running on EKS are fused into a single node (box b0). The metadata repository (MetaStore combining Elasticsearch and Neo4j) is mapped to OpenSearch. The central data lake is Amazon S3 (box b2, 60 TB). Ingestion and processing within the data lake boundary (container c0) use Apache Kafka and Amazon EMR, both exchanging data bidirectionally with S3. Container c0 also connects outwards to RDS and Vertica, represented here as data distribution from the central S3 data lake. External/upstream sources are mapped to UserCompanyDataStream, consumer/business applications interacting with EMR are mapped to UserCompanyInternalPlatform, and the isolated whiteboard box DA/DS is preserved as UserCompanyAnalyst with no edges, adhering strictly to rule 10.
respuesta.nombre: Enterprise Streaming Platform and S3 Data Lake
